question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Maleficent
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Maleficent"** means causing harm or destruction, especially by supernatural means. (दुष्ट)

 
 
• **Example: **The **maleficent** witch cast a spell on the village, causing chaos and fear.
 
 
 
• **"Delightful"** refers to something that brings great pleasure or joy. (आनंददायक)
 
 
• **Example: **The** delightful** aroma of freshly baked cookies filled the house.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the** opposite **of **'Maleficent'** is **'Delightful'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Obedient** (आज्ञाकारी): Willing to comply with orders or requests; submissive to another's will.

 
 
• **Example:** The obedient dog followed every command his owner gave.
 
 
 
• **Thorough** (संपूर्ण): Complete with regard to every detail; not superficial or partial.
 
 
• **Example:** She gave the room a thorough cleaning before the guests arrived.
 
 
 
• **Bad** (बुरा): Of poor quality or a low standard; not good.
 
 
• **Example:** He had a bad experience at the new restaurant.
 
 

 

37:Tb2e,

The correct answer is: Option 1.</
